mission_08: Dynamic graphs evolve over time, with nodes and edges appearing, disappearing, or changing features. Examples include social networks where friendships form and dissolve, traffic networks with time-varying congestion, and financial transaction graphs. Dynamic GNNs combine spatial graph aggregation with temporal modeling to capture both structural and temporal patterns. The EvolveGCN and DyRep architectures use RNNs (like GRUs) to update node representations across time steps, while temporal attention mechanisms weigh the importance of different historical snapshots. This mission implements a GRU-style temporal update that combines the previous hidden state with the current GNN encoding, plus temporal attention that learns which time steps are most relevant for prediction.
